title: BARS BENEATH THE WAVES // DISS TRACK FOR THE RED GOD
narrative: Patchface jumps onto the courtyard well at Castle Black, rotating his tattooed cap. 'Under the sea, the flames burn cold / Your Red God's a fraud who is ten years old! / The crows eat shadows, the shadows eat king / But the drowned merman got the heaviest bling! / I know, I know, oh oh oh!' Melisandre drops her ruby choker in shock. 'His rhymes... they possess greater prophetic cadence than the sacred scrolls of Asshai!'
introducesPlotHole: Rhymes Under the Sea Diss Track Protocol

options.text: Decipher the rest of the under-the-sea prophecies.
Recruit Lord Varys for a merling rap duo in the capital.
Have Melisandre resurrect Jon Snow as a backup singer.
